sources.purpose: Regulatory filing supports the December 16, 2025 closing, the JVPTR buyer chain, the named KKR-managed fund and 50/50 post-closing ownership of Maverick.
Official announcement supports the 1.4 GW North American portfolio boundary, 50% stake, value and TotalEnergies operator role.
SEC filing supports the December 2025 closing, consideration, retained 50% interest and portfolio capacity.
Merger-control filing identifies both legal targets, United States and Canadian scope, and 50/50 joint control.
Official TotalEnergies source supports the Alberta Big Sky asset and its pre-transaction ownership history.

exitSearch: No later sale, recapitalization, dilution, transfer, termination or signed exit affecting the 2025 KKR co-investment was identified through September 1, 2026; the later European portfolio transaction is separate.
